
{{alias}}( x1, x2 )
    Returns an iterator which iterates over the Cartesian product of two
    array-like objects.

    The order of the returned tuples follows the order of iteration of the
    provided array-like objects, with elements of the second array-like object
    varying fastest.

    If provided one or more empty array-like objects, the returned iterator is
    empty.

    If an environment supports Symbol.iterator, the returned iterator is
    iterable.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x1: ArrayLikeObject
        First input array.

    x2: ArrayLikeObject
        Second input array.

    Returns
    -------
    iterator: Object
        Iterator.

    iterator.next(): Function
        Returns an iterator protocol-compliant object containing the next
        iterated value (if one exists) and a boolean flag indicating whether the
        iterator is finished.

    iterator.return( [value] ): Function
        Finishes an iterator and returns a provided value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var it = {{alias}}( [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] );
    > var v = it.next().value
    [ 1, 3 ]
    > v = it.next().value
    [ 1, 4 ]
    > v = it.next().value
    [ 2, 3 ]

    See Also
    --------
